body: There are actually 4 different places where `kotlin.version` is defined, sadly.  so you'll need to change it in more than one place.  Alternately, you might try setting `-Dkotlin.version=1.4.0` and that should catch it everywhere in the meantime.

Thanks for the super quick feedback.

My workaround so far is to add the 4 Kotlin dependencies (even the ones I don't use) in the `<dependency-management>` section of my POM.

Hey, I have a similar problem that I'm not able to work out.

I need to use kotlin 1.4 in a gradle build, but updating the plugin version does not work 

```
plugins {
    id 'org.jetbrains.kotlin.jvm' version "1.4.10"
    id "org.jetbrains.kotlin.plugin.allopen" version "1.4.10"
    id 'io.quarkus'
}
```

- `./gradlew dependencies` still shows that `org.jetbrains.kotlin:kotlin-stdlib-jdk8:1.3.72` is being used. 

I can't see any kotlin.version flags anywhere and `-Dkotlin.version=1.4.0` doesn't seem to work.

I tried setting the stdlib to be strictly 1.4.0

```
    implementation ('org.jetbrains.kotlin:kotlin-stdlib-jdk8') {
        version {
            strictly "1.4.0"
        }
        because "we need it"
    }
```

but that just makes it output

```
      > Cannot find a version of 'org.jetbrains.kotlin:kotlin-stdlib-jdk8' that satisfies the version constraints:
           Dependency path xxxxx:1.0-bb74663' --> 'org.jetbrains.kotlin:kotlin-stdlib-jdk8:{strictly 1.4.10}' because of the following reason: we need it
           Constraint path 'xxxx:1.0-bb74663' --> 'io.quarkus:quarkus-universe-bom:1.8.1.Final' --> 'org.jetbrains.kotlin:kotlin-stdlib-jdk8:1.3.72'
```

Is this just not possible with quarkus?

@dylanenabled Did you manage to get this resolved? I am falling into the same issue.
Thanks
No, I just ended up not using the library that required it sorry.

There are at least 2 quarkus things that seem to break when declaring Kotlin version 1.4 (actually 1.4.10) in a local BOM, and attempting to use Quarkus 1.9.2. 

1. Jackson (for JSON rendering, and hence, JaxRS) seems not to work with kotlin 1.4
2. CDI injection breaks; in terms of injecting DataSources, it seems to add an additional @ Named qualifier which is not matched. 

It is currently rather difficult to combine quarkus with other libraries built with kotlin; both tend to have long chains of carefully curated dependencies ... implying that it quickly degenerates into a lot of POM configuration to get things to work.

```kotlin
@Inject
@DataSource("service")
lateinit var serviceDataSource: AgroalDataSource
```

Yields an Exception claiming that the qualifier annotation `@Named("service")` is added to the serviceDataSource field as well. This is not mentioned in the docs at all, and CDI fails to resolve it.
BTW, I discovered that if you use the Quarkus BOM, the Kotlin version gets downgraded from `1.4` to `1.3`.
1.4 is the default now so this could be closed, no?
with UniverseBOM 1.12.0.Final i use 1.4.20, but not 1.4.31
ok.  I can bump that up, then.
